links.outcome: AI diabetic retinopathy sensitivity and specificity by fundus camera platform
links.effect: AI-1 sensitivity 97.5% (Forus) vs 81.7% (Intuvision); specificity 62.7% vs 53.8%. AI-2 sensitivity 80.0% and 77.0%; specificity 95.7% and 92.0%. AI-3 sensitivity 73-80%, specificity 82-86%.
links.quote: AI performance varied across camera platforms, highlighting the need for context-specific validation to ensure safe integration into primary care and guide DR screening guidelines.

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating three commercial AI algorithms across two fundus cameras in a real-world primary care setting. It measures model accuracy rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
